name: General HyperFrames Video Workflow
summary: Author longer, multi-scene or freeform HyperFrames videos when no specialized workflow fits the brief.
problem: Open-ended video briefs often do not fit a narrow template and need a deliberate design, scene plan and build workflow.
coreOutcomes: Plan a visual system and multi-scene structure
Build, validate and prepare the composition for rendering
requirements: A HyperFrames project and its CLI
boundaries: Use a specialized workflow when the request is clearly a product launch, website tour, topic explainer, PR video, captioned clip or short motion graphic
The workflow does not itself provide the HyperFrames runtime or media-provider credentials
